wsjHeadlines.title: The Playboy Who Inherited an Empire of Gunfighters and Gold Smugglers
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, investors show they are alive to one of the big risks in AI, and Zelensky decides to take a risk and publicly confront Trump.

wsjHeadlines.title: The AI Stock Market Wobble Is a Reminder: This Time Isn’t Different
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial intelligence build-out hasn’t shown it can avoid the problems of past massive capital projects, such as railways and the internet.

wsjHeadlines.title: My Daughter and I Went Into Business Together. It Has Been an Adjustment.
wsjHeadlines.description: I’ve learned that boomers and millennials live on different workplace planets. But it’s one of the most-rewarding experiences I’ve ever had.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nearly All Volume on FIFA-Linked Prediction Market Is Circular Trading
wsjHeadlines.description: ADI Predictstreet, backed by Abu Dhabi’s royal family, paid close to $150 million for advertising rights during the World Cup.

wsjHeadlines.title: It’s Too Late for Small Fixes at Pepsi
wsjHeadlines.description: The problem may be bigger than a few weak brands. Pepsi needs to stop tinkering and consider more fundamental changes.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Popular Tax-Saving Trade is Juicing Wall Street’s Borrowing Binge
wsjHeadlines.description: Margin loan balances at Charles Schwab swelled to nearly $190 billion in the third quarter, fueled by the growth of one tax-loss harvesting strategy.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Agents Bring New Headaches to Online Sellers
wsjHeadlines.description: AI agents inserting themselves between businesses and customers pose challenges for e-commerce players caught in the middle.

wsjHeadlines.title: Rising Rates Threaten Wall Street’s Golden Goose in Trading
wsjHeadlines.description: Weak bond markets undermine what had been a strength for big banks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stubborn Sellers Are the Last Thing Propping Up Home Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: Mortgage rates above 7% might not be enough to crack home values if owners hold the line.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gulf Hurricane Not Big Enough to Reset Insurance Market
wsjHeadlines.description: Capital flowing into insurance might actually be weakening the sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Agents Are a Threat to Travel Businesses. Airbnb Could Still Be a Winner.
wsjHeadlines.description: For the lodging platform’s stock to thrive in the age of bots, it has to turn repeat customers into loyal ones.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Swiss Banking Giant Thinks the Unthinkable: Moving Out of Switzerland
wsjHeadlines.description: The bank has received approaches from potential U.S. deal partners as it publicly spars with Swiss politicians over substantially higher capital requirements.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Intercontinental Exchange, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, State Street and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Worries Bank of America’s Problems Will Linger
wsjHeadlines.description: Weak earnings coupled with a fine has analysts pressing executives about whether there is more pain to come.

wsjHeadlines.title: The AI Boom Is Supercharging Wall Street’s Profits
wsjHeadlines.description: Investment banking revenues are up, and wealth-management divisions are winning new AI millionaires as clients.

wsjHeadlines.title: Debanking Probe Finds JPMorgan, Banks Cut Off MAGA Sellers and Democrat Groups
wsjHeadlines.description: An investigation by a Trump regulator detailed examples of businesses and individuals getting shut out by the nation’s biggest banks.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Agents Trading Stocks While You Sleep? Charles Schwab’s CEO Is Skeptical
wsjHeadlines.description: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster is betting some money and investing needs require a human touch.

wsjHeadlines.title: Who Gets the Bulk of Grandma’s Estate? Here’s How to Solve the ‘Cousin Problem’
wsjHeadlines.description: Passing assets to later generations often triggers conflict, but proactive bonding, fair ownership structures and open communication can safeguard your legacy.

wsjHeadlines.title: Blue Owl Founders Promised a Comeback. The Company’s Share Price Hasn’t Budged.
wsjHeadlines.description: Executives at the private-credit giant have been trying to reassure employees, yet Blue Owl stock is down about 67% from its record high in January 2025.

wsjHeadlines.title: New Cracks in AI Trade Push Wall Street to Worst Week Since June
wsjHeadlines.description: A stock rout swept up companies from CoreWeave to Alphabet while Treasury yields tumbled.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Fall as Credit Fears Haunt Tech Sector
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell as fears mounted that artificial-intelligence profits would not come soon enough to meet increasingly expensive credit obligations for CoreWeave and other aspiring hyperscalers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on AirCanada, BYD and more in the latest Market Talks covering Auto and Transport.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Apple’s iPhone Duo, Proofpoint, Shopify and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Volatile Week Ends with Tech Stocks Down, Oil Up
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Tesla’s Roadster launch gets a cool reception, and companies don’t like stock tokenization.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech Stocks Slump as Nasdaq Faces Weekly Loss
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell, led by the Nasdaq composite, as chip and AI-related shares came under new pressure.

wsjHeadlines.title: From Verizon to UnitedHealth, Corporate America Is Balking at ‘Tokenized’ Stocks
wsjHeadlines.description: Broadcom and other companies have objected to tokenizing their shares under a new regulatory framework.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | For Investors and Savers, TINA Is Giving Way to TARA
wsjHeadlines.description: Rising Treasury yields mean stocks will become less attractive, interest-bearing accounts more so.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | To Give Investors Certainty, Reform Permitting
wsjHeadlines.description: America needs new sources of capital, but it also needs a more predictable path to building projects.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Market’s Rude Reminder on AI
wsjHeadlines.description: Sooner or later investors will demand returns, and there will be losers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The End of the Libor Fraud Persecution
wsjHeadlines.description: A flagrant attempt to scapegoat bankers for the last crisis collapses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | America Needs More Capital
wsjHeadlines.description: Economic growth will solve the debt problem and keep us ahead in AI. That will require new investors.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Modernize and Reform the Recycling System
wsjHeadlines.description: The answer isn’t to abandon it but rather to fix it through private-sector innovation, policy standardization and targeted materials recovery.

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold futures, Press Metal Aluminium and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Energy & Utilities Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on oil prices and more in the latest Market Talks covering Energy and Utilities.

wsjHeadlines.title: Crude Futures Rise on Persistent Supply Jitters
wsjHeadlines.description: The oil market shook off early lethargy and pushed prices higher as conflict in the Middle East and Ukraine’s renewed targeting of Russian refineries fueled supply concerns.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Settle Lower
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures fell as the market looked beyond this weekend’s cold spell in the Northeast that is expected to drive up residential and commercial heating demand.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Edge Up As U.S. Dollar Slips
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures settled modestly higher as the U.S. dollar weakened for a second session, with gains limited by a slight uptick in U.S. yields.

wsjHeadlines.title: Major Cryptocurrencies Mostly Higher as Dollar Eases
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar weakened as odds increased that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady this month. Major cryptocurrencies got a boost as the dollar eased..

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.32% to 97.26
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index fell 0.3% — down two of the past three trading days.
